questions.questionText:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming
the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts,
decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.
Statements: 
 
All purses are rupees.
 
Some rupees are coins.
Conclusions:
 
I. Some purses are coins.
II. No purse is coin.
 
III. No rupee is coin.
options: Only Conclusion I and III follow.
Only Conclusion I and II follow.
Only Conclusion II and III follow.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (B).
